heading: What's On
intro: Three days of celebration. Come for the wedding, stay for the everything around it.

days.title: Welcome Party
days.description: Check in from 16:00 — Erin & Ryan will already be there, so come whenever suits you. The evening kicks off with freshly made pizzas from 19:30 (tbc) on the estate.
days.details: Check-in from 16:00 · Pizza from 19:30 (tbc) · Estate terrace

days.title: The Wedding
days.description: The reason we're all here. The ceremony begins around 16:30–17:00 (tbc), followed by an aperitivo hour, dinner, dancing and an evening snack. Full menu to follow closer to the time. Party until 01:00.
days.note: There's a restaurant and bar on site, and most apartments have a kitchen or kitchenette. On the morning of the wedding, the wedding party will be having breakfast in the restaurant — all welcome to join or do your own thing.

days.title: BBQ & Pool Party
days.description: The slow, happy comedown. Kicking off from 14:00 — food will be provided along with a selection of drinks, but feel free to BYOB. Lounge by the pool, dig into a long lazy barbecue and toast the weekend one last time. Bring your swimsuit — and leave your shoes behind.
days.details: From 14:00 · Food & drinks provided · BYOB welcome · Pool & sunshine
